data.title: Oura and Backers Target $2.2 Billion in US IPO
data.description: Oura Inc., the health and fitness ring maker, and some of its backers are seeking to raise as much as $2.2 billion in a US initial public offering, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Kevin O'Leary Says Ethereum May Not Become Industry Standard
data.description:
Kevin O'Leary said Ethereum may not become the standard across industry sectors, citing its transaction speed as a key limitation. According to NS3.AI, he pointed to Solana and Avalanche as networks that could draw investor interest as new facts emerge.

O'Leary said investors may need to rebalance their positions as the market develops. At the time of writing, Solana processed more than 1,262 transactions per second, compared with 22.44 for Ethereum and 10.40 for Avalanche, according to Chainspect.

data.title: AI Adoption to Keep Danske Bank Workforce Shrinking
data.description:
Danske Bank A/S expects its workforce to keep shrinking in coming years as customer needs change and the lender adopts artificial intelligence and other technology, according to Bloomberg.

A top executive said the bank is increasing its use of AI and other tools as part of that shift.

data.title: Chicago Fed President Goolsbee: Fed Can Return to 2% Inflation Path Without More Evidence of Overheating Demand
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Chicago Fed President Austan D. Goolsbee said he is optimistic the Federal Reserve can return to a 2% inflation path as long as there is no more evidence of overheated demand, and that he is still sorting out how much of inflation comes from supply shocks and how much comes from demand.

data.title: FX Currency Swaps Market Pushes to Automate Phone-Based Trading
data.description: The $4 trillion-a-day currency swaps market is trying to reduce its reliance on dealers picking up the phone, with trading venues seeking to automate a stubbornly manual corner of foreign exchange, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Goldman Sees Value in Virgin Media O2 and VodafoneZiggo Bonds
data.description:
Goldman Sachs Group Inc. traders are urging credit investors to revisit some of the beaten-down bonds issued by Virgin Media O2 and VodafoneZiggo, according to Bloomberg.

The recommendation comes months after weaker earnings and rising competition pushed the telecom companies’ debt lower.

data.title: X Sues Two Users Over Alleged Fake Bitcoin News Account Scheme
data.description: X is suing Vivek Kumar Sen and Zmyang Sherpa over an alleged network of fake bitcoin news accounts that sought payouts from X's creator fund. According to NS3.AI, X terminated the accounts on Aug. 18 and is seeking repayment of at least 207,000 pounds ($277,000) in disputed payouts, along with damages for alleged fraud and conspiracy.

data.title: Vanguard Says US Investors Are Rotating From Stocks Into Bonds
data.description:
Ursula Marchioni, Vanguard's Europe head of multi-asset and adviser solutions, said investors are seeing a "redesign of fixed income benchmarks in portfolios," according to Bloomberg.

She said US investors are showing "huge diversification and huge rotation" out of equities and into fixed income, while Europe remains an "untapped opportunity." Marchioni spoke on Bloomberg Television.

data.title: Hyperliquid's Largest Bitcoin Short Adds to Position as BTC Rises
data.description:
On September 21, TradingBeats monitoring showed that the address 0xfc27, labeled on the platform as Polymarket user "VBVIT" and identified as Hyperliquid's largest BTC short, continued adding to its short position as BTC climbed. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the address held a 1,320.73 BTC short position with an average entry price of about $79,470.40, using 25x leverage.

As of press time, BTC was trading at about $84,547, leaving the account with an unrealized loss of about $6.7048 million and a liquidation price of about $86,951.25, less than 3% above the current price. Recent trade records showed the address also added to its short position when BTC traded between about $82,700 and $83,300.

The address also held about $76.46 million in ETH shorts, with an unrealized loss of about $4.44 million. Its 87 perpetual positions together showed an unrealized loss of about $13.84 million.

data.title: USDD Adds $12.8 Million in Market Value on September 20, Ranks Third Among Stablecoin Issuers
data.description:
USDD's market value increased by $12.8 million on September 20, placing the decentralized stablecoin third among stablecoin issuers, behind Ethena at $35.8 million and StablR at $18.7 million. According to Foresight News, the figures were cited by RWA Foundation from Token Terminal data.

USDD's circulating supply stands at $1.54 billion, ranking 10th among all stablecoins, while the protocol's total value locked reached $2.29 billion.

data.title: Polymarket LoL Submarket Jumps to 48.5% on Baron Kill Outcome
data.description: A Polymarket submarket tied to the LoL match between FENNEL and Cupid Esports in the World Star Challenger Invitational Group C saw the probability of the “Yes” option for both teams killing Baron swing sharply from 0.5% one hour earlier to 48.5%. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 48% fluctuation and may have been affected by breaking news.

data.title: Jiang Zhuoer Says Bitcoin Is Following His Expected Path Toward an 83K-84K Resistance Test
data.description: Jiang Zhuoer, founder of BTC.com mining pool, said Bitcoin is moving in line with one of his previously published scenarios: testing the 83,000 to 84,000 resistance zone before entering a larger pullback. According to ChainCatcher, he added that this pattern does not appear to mark the market top and said he is waiting rather than shorting, while holding a full spot ETH position in anticipation of a rise.

data.title: PancakeSwap’s First Pre-Access pPOLY Sale Sells Out Quickly
data.description: PancakeSwap’s first Pre-Access project, pPOLY, sold out shortly after subscriptions opened at 17:00 (UTC+8) on September 21. According to Odaily, 309,677.42 pPOLY were offered at $15.5 each, with total issuance of about $4.8 million and an implied valuation of $15.5 billion.

data.title: Smart Money Address Holds Large BTC and ETH Long Positions With Over $30.78 Million in Unrealized Gains
data.description:
A smart money address opened long positions in Bitcoin and Ether in early July with $85.36 million, and its unrealized gains have now exceeded $30.78 million. According to Foresight News, the address beginning with 0x15a currently holds a 40x long on 1,000 BTC, valued at $83.9 million, with an entry price of $62,353.6 and unrealized gains of $21.42 million.

It also holds a 20x long on 10,000 ETH, valued at $27.01 million, with an entry price of $1,761.94 and unrealized gains of $9.36 million. The address is the largest profitable BTC address on Hyperliquid.

data.title: India Reviews U.S. Tariff Details on Russian Oil Buyers, Trade Minister Says
data.description: India is reviewing the details of U.S. tariffs targeting buyers of Russian oil, Trade Minister Piyush Goyal said. According to ChainCatcher, the move follows a U.S. House bill that would authorize the president to impose punitive tariffs of up to 100% on India and other countries.

data.title: SecondFi Warns Affected Wallet Users of NIGHT Claim Risk on September 22
data.description:
SecondFi warned users affected by a previous security incident to be cautious about claiming NIGHT tokens. According to Foresight News, some affected users will have a NIGHT claim window on September 22, but Midnight Foundation systems only allow claims from the original wallet address, and users cannot switch to another unaffected address.

SecondFi said the compromised wallets remain permanently vulnerable, and it advised users not to attempt to claim NIGHT through those wallets because the tokens could be stolen. It added that the NIGHT claim process is managed independently by the Midnight Foundation, while its wallet migration tool and asset recovery tool do not cover NIGHT claims. Affected users were told to contact the Midnight Foundation directly.

SecondFi previously suffered a security incident from June 21 to 23, during which about 16.1 million ADA were stolen from 374 wallets.
